newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans life insurance for soldiers.
newsitem.headline: China plans life insurance for soldiers.

text.p: China's military leaders have set up an office to research ways to provide members of the three-million-strong People's Liberation Army with life insurance and other benefits, state media said.

The Central Military Commission had approved an insurance office in Beijing to work out laws and rules to ensure military casualties were taken care of, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.

China would create a special fund to help military personnel and their families obtain compensation for deaths or injuries in the line of duty, the agency said, adding there would be some benefits for discharged soldiers.

The life insurance system would be considered a special social welfare policy to maintain stability and order among the troops and to protect their rights and interests, it said without giving further details.
